intended_object: A witness (a `Functor.FullyFaithful` structure) that the forgetful functor from sheafed spaces to presheafed spaces is fully faithful, i.e. that SheafedSpace C is a full subcategory of PresheafedSpace C. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: This is the proof-relevant packaging of a fact: the functor `SheafedSpace C ⥤ PresheafedSpace C` is fully faithful. A `FullyFaithful` value is unique and holds the same information as the statement "full and faithful", so mathematically this is a lemma, not an object being defined. As a witness it is correct: SheafedSpace is set up as an induced (full) subcategory of PresheafedSpace, `forgetToPresheafedSpace` is the induced inclusion functor, and `InducedCategory.homMk` gives the inverse on hom-sets, with the compatibility conditions holding by definition.
